description: A procurement lead is choosing an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. Conflict: The Finance team wants Cost-Efficiency, but the Sales team wants a specific UX that is only available in the most expensive option. They need to find a middle ground or a tiered rollout strategy.

user_profile.context: Finalizing the vendor shortlist, internal stakeholders are fighting

fact_sheet.fact: The internal name for the ERP system procurement initiative at Stellar Innovations Inc. is 'Project Fusion'.
The lead for Project Fusion is Ben Carter, the Procurement Lead.
The executive sponsor for Project Fusion is Anya Sharma, the Operations Director.
The deadline for the final vendor selection is November 30, 2024.
David Chen, Head of Finance, is the primary advocate for the most cost-efficient ERP solution.
Maria Garcia, Head of Sales, is the primary advocate for the ERP solution with the best User Experience (UX) for her team.
Kenji Tanaka, the IT Lead, is responsible for assessing the technical feasibility and integration costs of each option.
The premium ERP option is the 'OmniCore Suite' from vendor Synapse Dynamics.
OmniCore Suite's annual license fee is quoted at $450,000 for 500 enterprise users.
The specific feature requested by the Sales team in OmniCore Suite is the 'Dynamic Lead Dashboard'.
The one-time implementation cost for OmniCore Suite is estimated at $120,000.
The budget-friendly ERP option is 'CoreLogic ERP' from vendor Integra Solutions.
CoreLogic ERP's annual license fee is quoted at $180,000 for 500 enterprise users.
CoreLogic ERP does not have a native customizable sales dashboard but offers a standard API for integration with the existing CRM.
The one-time implementation cost for CoreLogic ERP is estimated at $55,000.
A middle-ground option, 'ConnectSphere ERP' from vendor Apex Digital, has been identified.
ConnectSphere ERP's base annual license fee is $290,000 for 500 users.
ConnectSphere ERP offers an 'Advanced Sales Module' with enhanced UX for an additional $50,000 per year.
The one-time implementation cost for ConnectSphere ERP (base package) is estimated at $80,000.
The total approved budget for Project Fusion in Year 1 (license + implementation) is $400,000.
The projected 5-year Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) for OmniCore Suite is $2.5 million.
The projected 5-year TCO for CoreLogic ERP is $1.1 million, as calculated by the Finance department.
The projected 5-year TCO for ConnectSphere ERP with the Advanced Sales Module is $1.83 million.
The most recent stakeholder alignment meeting occurred on October 25, 2024, in Conference Room 3B.
During the October 25 meeting, Maria Garcia stated that forgoing the requested UX features would decrease new lead conversion rates by a projected 8%.
During the October 25 meeting, David Chen warned that exceeding the Year 1 budget by more than 10% would require deferring the planned Q1 2025 warehouse automation upgrade.
The final decision-making meeting for Project Fusion is scheduled for November 15, 2024, at 10:00 AM PST via the company's secure video conference link.
Anya Sharma proposed a tiered rollout strategy for ConnectSphere ERP as a potential compromise.
The proposed tiered rollout involves implementing the base ConnectSphere ERP for Finance and Operations in Q1 2025.
Under the tiered plan, the 'Advanced Sales Module' for ConnectSphere ERP would be purchased and rolled out in Q3 2025, contingent on H1 performance.
Kenji Tanaka's assessment noted that CoreLogic ERP's API integration with the current CRM ('SalesForce') would require 120 hours of developer time from the IT department.

user_needs.description: Who are the primary stakeholders advocating for the cost-efficient and the user experience-focused ERP solutions?
Which ERP option is the Sales team advocating for, and which UX feature is driving that preference?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After identifying the competing stakeholders, the next natural step is to look at the specific ERP option and UX capability driving Sales' preference.

user_needs.description: What are the annual license and one-time implementation costs for the OmniCore Suite?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Once the premium product and its key feature are identified, the next logical question is about its cost.

user_needs.description: What is the name of the budget-friendly ERP option, and what is its annual license fee?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After learning the high cost of the premium option, the user will want to understand the details of the budget alternative championed by Finance.

user_needs.description: Has a middle-ground option been identified, and what is its base annual license fee?
Does the ConnectSphere ERP offer an advanced module for the Sales team, and what is its additional annual cost?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After learning about a mid-range option, the user needs to know if it can satisfy the specific stakeholder (Sales) requirement that started the conflict.

user_needs.description: What is the total approved budget for Project Fusion in Year 1?
What happens if Year 1 spend is forecast to exceed the approved budget by more than 10%?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After reviewing the approved budget, a direct next question is what consequence or escalation is triggered if spend goes materially over it.

user_needs.description: What does the proposed tiered rollout strategy for ConnectSphere ERP involve in phase one?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing the optional advanced Sales module and its cost, a natural next question is what a phased compromise rollout would include in phase one.

user_needs.description: Under the proposed tiered plan, when would the Advanced Sales Module be rolled out and what is that rollout contingent on?
What was the IT Lead's assessment of the developer time required to integrate the CoreLogic ERP with the current CRM?
When is the final Project Fusion decision meeting scheduled, and how will it be held?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing the proposed phased compromise, a practical follow-up is to confirm when the final decision forum is scheduled and how it will be conducted.
